title: Craftable End Portal Frames
description: A data pack that adds a way to craft end portal frames
body:
# Overview
A very simple data pack that adds a recipe for end portal frames. The recipe is fairly complex and requires materials from multiple areas of the world.

![Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SgDMQnYJ/images/f93df9f2907939dbcf86724c3e6ade4468db2561.png)
